notes.title: Second bug fix!

notes.title: Quick Bug Fix
notes.content: There was a bug with the achievements, but hopefully they should be working now! Please let me know if they aren't.

notes.title: Phoenyx: Breaking The Cycle now available!
notes.content: [p]Phoenyx: Breaking The Cycle is now available for purchase! If you're interested, please check out the game and leave a review! If you want to know about current and future projects, please check out the Youtube or X profiles![/p]

notes.title: Phoenyx: Breaking The Cycle Release Date!
notes.content: [p]Phoenyx: Breaking The Cycle will be released at 1 PM on August 29th! I hope you enjoy it when it releases![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653397/a4d00916a2a44b62d3734484a3e71847d3a16cc1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Phoenyx: Breaking The Cycle releasing this month!
notes.content: [p]Phoenyx: Breaking The Cycle is almost done, and the final version is currently in playtesting stages! It will be released sometime this month for $5! The official release date will be announced very soon![/p]
